entries.note: All members pooled (5 November models for DJF lead 2-4; 6 models for the decade). Rows: DJF lead months 2-4, one value per start date; the s1961/s1978 decade with each model's month-of-year climatology removed. Excess I(M; X, Y) where p <= 0.05, exact nulls (per-member detrend inside the test; per start date / 12-month blocks), 200 permutations. Inputs: $SNP_OUT/exchangeability_grid_{VAR}_2-4_redetrend.npz, _{VAR}_{s1961,s1978}moy_block12_redetrend.npz.

CanESM5 alone. Rows: DJF lead months 12-14 (CanESM5 starts in January, so its first full DJF is a year after the start), one value per start date; the s1961/s1978 decade, month-of-year climatology removed. Same statistic, nulls, colour scale and area axis as exchangeability-all-models. Inputs: $SNP_OUT/exchangeability_grid_{VAR}_CanESM5_12-14_redetrend.npz, _{VAR}_{s1961,s1978}moy_CanESM5_block12_redetrend.npz.
